messages:
Lina (UX): tossing out a concise change: regroup sidebar into 'Workflows' > Models | Datasets | Endpoints. reduces clutter on top-level.
Mike R (Frontend): ok but we must keep permalink stability. external links currently hit /console/models/:id.
Lina (UX): plan: new UI grouping, canonical URL shape: /console/workflows/:kind/:id. support legacy routes via redirects.
Sam (Eng): technical: will add edge redirect table + client router mapping. prefer 307/308 flip strategy. also preserve querystring.
Priya (A11y): accessibility reminder: when toggling groups, use <button aria-expanded> and announce nav changes with an ARIA live region. move focus to h1 after route change.
Ana (PM): marketing asking for final link format today. can we freeze the canonical shape?
Mike R (Frontend): freeze approved: /console/workflows/:kind/:id[/subview]. breadcrumbs derive from resource displayName, not slug.
Sam (Eng): sample routes:
/console/workflows/models/12345            -> overview
/console/workflows/models/12345/metrics   -> metrics
/console/workflows/models/12345/logs      -> logs
Mike R (Frontend): prefer history entries for subviews (so back button works). avoid hash-only subviews.
Priya (A11y): also ensure skip-to-main is present and that collapsed nav doesn't trap keyboard focus.
Lina (UX): UX: show pretty name in breadcrumb but keep stable id in URL (e.g., 12345-my-llama). client should accept cosmetic slug changes.
Sam (Eng): I'll add redirect health-check and a redirect_hit telemetry counter. basePath-aware redirect for private installs.
nav-bot: staging deploy with route changes scheduled 2025-03-02T10:00Z.
Ana (PM): migration plan: 2-week notice, 90-day redirects. docs update scheduled after redirects are stable.
Mike R (Frontend): I'll add tests for breadcrumb label precedence and keyboard nav.
Lina (UX): quick usability check on staging tomorrow? 10 minutes to verify back-button + focus + breadcrumbs.
Sam (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/712 (redirects + router changes). tagging reviewers.
Ana (PM): thanks all, will prepare release blurb. :thumbsup:
